title: Reliquary round 4: the designs developed (12, green)
desc: J on v2.0102: "ports are bigger slightly better on the small ones but it shouldnt have been the main focus of the new round". He picked "Develop the designs", all green: two new directions for each 612 pick (KEEP R2a, R4a, R4b; IMPROVE R1c, R6c, R2b), the 2.25x lit port kept. Stills at frame 118.
